summary: 2D texture copy with column-wise output placement. Reads column count (field +0x20) and per-segment byte length (field +0x5C) from the surface object a1, then for each of a5 output rows and each column i in [0, column count) copies the byte segment addressed through a DWORD index table a2 (source pointer = v8 + a2[i], with v8 advancing by 4 per output row) into the output column starting at *a4 + i using a vertical stride of column count. Guarded by output row count a5 being at least 1.

local_names.a4: array of per-output-row base pointers, advanced each row
local_names.v13: column count, inner loop bound and destination vertical stride
local_names.v5: segment byte length, number of bytes copied per column
